title: Reliability and removed features after ownership
summary: Feedback in this topic centers on perceived reliability after taking ownership and complaints that certain convenience or driver-assist controls were removed, while many remaining fragments are too context-limited or loosely related to support a clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews say the vehicle has been reliable since delivery or compared with a previous vehicle.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on unreliable internet connectivity and frustration that door-lock, ACC, and drive-assist steering-wheel controls were removed.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention varied issues such as learning where functions are located, repairs, refunds, carwash use, and sparse ownership comments without enough context for a clear sentiment.

limitations: Many fragments are brief or incomplete, so the dominant sentiment is often unclear.
The topic cluster mixes reliability, removed features, refunds, repairs, and generic uses of the word 'took,' which reduces thematic coherence.
Examples are insufficient to determine whether some refund, repair, or learning-curve mentions are positive or negative beyond the assigned undetermined label.
